description: A daily-rebalanced long-only equity strategy driven by a composite ranking score (momentum, RSI, and volatility) as a stand-in for AI-predicted returns. It selects the top K stocks from a configurable universe (e.g., CSI 300), assigns equal weight, limits per-stock exposure, and controls risk via maximum drawdown and turnover penalties. A-share transaction costs (0.03% buy, 0.13% sell) and 100-share lot size are respected.

parameters.universe: Index ticker for universe (e.g., '000300' for CSI 300)
parameters.top-k: Number of top stocks to hold, default 10
parameters.stop-loss-from-high: Individual stop loss from recent high (negative), e.g., -0.08

risk_controls: Portfolio maximum drawdown threshold: liquidate all if exceeded
Individual stop-loss: exit position if price drops more than X% from recent high
Turnover penalty implicitly captured by transaction costs; no explicit turnover constraint in this implementation

data_requirements.field: Volume, Price, Fundamental data for filtering
